company.name: HEVN
company.shortDescription: HEVN provides business banking, global payments, payroll, virtual accounts, and payment APIs for international companies.
company.description: HEVN provides a financial technology platform for cross-border businesses to manage banking-style workflows from a single dashboard. The platform lets companies open named local business accounts in multiple jurisdictions, including the EU, US, and UAE, and transact on local payment rails such as SEPA, ACH, wire, SWIFT, and UAEFTS. HEVN supports issuing and managing virtual corporate cards with spend controls and cashback on eligible company spend. Customers can generate invoices, collect payments via bank transfers or stablecoins, run bill pay and contractor payouts, and automate payables through APIs or AI agents. The product also offers reporting tools that export statements, categorize expenses, and track both fiat and crypto activity for accounting and audits. HEVN includes non-custodial smart contract wallet infrastructure so users control their digital assets while using stablecoins for settlement. Security features such as passkeys, two-factor authentication, and role-based permissions help organizations control access to financial operations.
